title: Teri Laash Ko Main Asghar Dafnaou Ab Kahan
body:
Dhoonday Gay Tujh Ko Naizay (x2) Chaaron Taraf Yahan.
<<DIVIDER>>
Jhoolay Main Ho Raha Hay, Kyun Bay Karar Dekho (x2)
Kaarvat Badal Raha Hay Kyun Baar Baar Dekho
Jab Say Sunee Hay Isnay (x2) Akbar Teri Azaan.
<<DIVIDER>>
Manzar Yeh Dekhtay Hi, Arsh-e-Bareen Hilla Hay (x2)
Ghutnon Kay Bal Hay Betha Chehray Peh Khoon Maala Hay
Sabir Hussain Jaisa (x2) Layta Hay Siskiyaan.
<<DIVIDER>>
Tera Mazaar Beta, Haathon Say Main Saajata (x2)
Afsos Meray Asghar Majboor Tera Baba
Khud Hi Mita Raha Hai (x2) Teri Qabr Ka Nishaan.
<<DIVIDER>>
Nazuk Galay Peh Vazni, Jo Teer Seh Gaya Hai (x2)
Roota Nahi Hay Bus Ye Gayoor Sochta Hay
Khaimon Say Cheekh Sun Kay (x2) Kahin Aana Jaye Maa.
<<DIVIDER>>
Fojh-e-Sitam Nay Dekhi, Taseer-e-Khoon-e-Haider (x2)
Dushman Ko Dekhtay Hain Asghar You Saar Utha Kaar
Lab Pay Hay Muskurahat (x2) Chehray Peh Itminaan.
<<DIVIDER>>
Saqlain Jab Bhi Hongay, Zahir Imam-e-Aakhir (x2)
Rutba Milayga Aala Sub Hongay Unkay Nokar
Asghar Kay Matami Aur (x2) Asghar Kay Noha Khan.
